video_title: Stewie's All-Star Weekend, LeBron's Big Move & Rookie Advice

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart confronts Myles Turner about leaving her All-Star game early
quotes.excerpt: Myles came to my game and he left before the fourth quarter.

text_blocks.speaker: Breanna Stewart
text_blocks.text: Myles came to my game and he left before the fourth quarter. We go into overtime and we win the game and my co-host left me.

text_blocks.speaker: Myles Turner
text_blocks.text: I left for overtime. I was there for the fourth quarter. I left for overtime.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner praises the New York Liberty's recent team performance
quotes.excerpt: It is interesting seeing the wings now because they have not been very good for many years.
quotes.quote: It is interesting seeing the wings now because they have not been very good for many years. I have been to a few of the games and it is interesting to see how the crowd gets behind them. They have some good players. I have never really seen Breanna Stewart play in person. She has a good pull-up game. It was fun to watch. Your team is good. It is just a matter of matter synergy. You have so many good players on your team. It is almost a matter of who is going to get the ball when.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart discusses the New York Liberty's chemistry and momentum
quotes.excerpt: Winning the last two games before All-Star break was not only good for everybody's mental.
quotes.quote: Dallas is good. They are playing really well. They have a young group and they have a great chemistry together. We talked about it on the show last week. My team, we are a little bit up and down, but honestly, winning the last two games before All-Star break was not only good for everybody's mental, but also just knowing that you have these three days where everybody can rest and relax and then we are back in it. Because you know, winning or losing two games can really put you in completely different positions. But this league is tough.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart and Myles Turner discuss A'ja Wilson's MVP season
quotes.excerpt: It was dope to see a friend of the podcast and your teammate A'ja Wilson getting MVP.

text_blocks.speaker: Myles Turner
text_blocks.text: It was dope to see a friend of the podcast and your teammate A'ja Wilson getting MVP. History in the making as well. I think I read that she has been Commissioner's Cup MVP, a Finals MVP, a league MVP, and now an All-Star Game MVP.

text_blocks.speaker: Breanna Stewart
text_blocks.text: I was really happy for A'ja. Sometimes with the All-Star Game, you never know how it is going to go because they want it to be competitive, but you do not have a lot of time. I thought we put on a pretty good show. My team ended up losing. A'ja had a near triple-double, but really cool to see her get that MVP nod, get appreciated by everybody else, and take something home with her from All-Star Weekend.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart reflects on her All-Star Weekend shooting game performance
quotes.excerpt: My team we won a shooting game. We played this money grab thing.
quotes.quote: My team we won a shooting game. We played this money grab thing where Becky was holding a hundred dollar bill and you have your fingers in between it and she is going to drop it and if you catch it you get to keep it. I caught it and then I made the half-court shot, so I cashed out. I really cashed out.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart shares her experience visiting the Obama Center
quotes.excerpt: I was really excited to go to the Obama Center. I did not know that we were.
quotes.quote: I was really excited to go to the Obama Center. I did not know that we were going to practice there originally, and I want to go back, but it is beautiful. When you go to Chicago, go see it. The building itself, but the outside, the park is very quiet, the playground is nice, and continuing to give Chicago as much as they can to uplift and elevate their city to be bigger and better and helping the people of Chicago. But talking to President Obama, I am lucky because I was able to meet him during his term, my four years at UConn, because we won all four years, so every year we just go, we go see President Obama and it just became like an annual thing.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner and Breanna Stewart discuss LeBron James' potential team move
quotes.excerpt: LeBron is going to the 76ers and I am pretty sure neither one of us said Philly.

text_blocks.speaker: Breanna Stewart
text_blocks.text: LeBron is going to the 76ers and I am pretty sure neither one of us said Philly. Did you say Philly?

text_blocks.speaker: Myles Turner
text_blocks.text: No, I think I said I think I said Miami if I remember properly. It is funny though because did you see that intern or whatever that like put out the I mean, what if LeBron on some petty shit was like, you know what, I was not going to go to Miami, but fuck it, I am going to Philly now.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner analyzes the shifting power dynamics in the NBA Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: The East is shaking up to be really something special for now for years to come.
quotes.quote: The East is shaking up to be really something special for now for years to come. You add LeBron back to the East, obviously one of the best players to ever do it. He brings a whole new market to Philly. As far as his fit on the floor, there are talks of him trying to play point guard a little bit, put Tyrese Maxey off the ball, go a little bit smaller with Jaylen Brown at the four, obviously you got Joel Embiid, a former MVP at the five. Then they got a solid bench. They got a friend of the podcast, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, as soon as he got bought out by Memphis and he is going to join the team. They got Dean Wade, they got Jabari Walker. They got a lot of guys coming off the bench that can make a big impact for them.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart discusses the impact of LeBron James' athleticism on his new team
quotes.excerpt: He now has like you said he has a lot of athleticism around him.
quotes.quote: He now has like you said he has a lot of athleticism around him. And I do not know if that was always the case with the Lakers. If you kind of think about the differences in the lineups, he has some real athletes where it is like he does not have to do it all. He can kind of let the young ones go after and make the crazy plays and the crazy blocks. We will still get them from him for sure.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner discusses LeBron James' floor vision and passing ability
quotes.excerpt: One of the most underrated things about him is his floor vision, his court vision.
quotes.quote: One of the most underrated things about him is his floor vision, his court vision. He is an excellent passer. He has always had the athletic freak, he has always obviously had the skills, but he is an excellent passer. So now you got young guys being in positions to be successful. And I am curious to see what his real impact is going to be with the team that hasn't had the playoff success that they have been projected to have.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner explains the value of a trade kicker in NBA contracts
quotes.excerpt: A trade kicker is basically like if the team decides to trade you, they have to give you.
quotes.quote: A trade kicker is basically like if the team decides to trade you, they have to give you 15% upfront of the remaining number on your salary. So if you still have to make for number sake, let's say you need 10 million, you have 10 million dollars more on your contract, if they decide to trade you, they have to pay you 15% of that 10 million right upfront. So it is literally just like they are cutting you a check right then and there just to get rid of you. But that is just the present value of money. So it is something that is very valuable and not a lot of people have on their contracts.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner's advice to rookies on time management and focus
quotes.excerpt: The very first thing that comes to mind is time management because when you are this is your job.
quotes.quote: The very first thing that comes to mind is time management because when you are this is your job now. It is literally your job to make sure you are as healthy as possible, you are in shape as possible, you are ready to go when it is game time, you are ready to practice. I think time management is a very big thing that gets a lot of kids in trouble. You have to learn to sit with your thoughts. You have to be able to stay off social media. You have to be able to stay off your phones for long periods of time. It is okay to stare out a window and just get lost in your own thoughts.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner advises rookies on managing relationships and avoiding 'yes men'
quotes.excerpt: You have to find a no guy. I think that is so important.
quotes.quote: If it isn't time management, I honestly think it is just managing the people around you. You made it, you are a guy, you are a star from your city, people look up to you. So more and more people are going to be hitting you up. You are on TV every single night. Your cousin's cousin's friend knows you. People haven't talked to in years know you. You have to find a no guy. I think that is so important. It is very easy to become a yes man at this level. So you have to make sure you have your no guy. Someone asks you for money, be like, go talk to this guy right here. Someone asks you to come out to do this appearance, be like, yeah, but you got to go talk to this guy right here.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the pressure of fighting for roster spots as a rookie
quotes.excerpt: In training camp, people are like fighting for jobs. You know to the point where you are like.
quotes.quote: In training camp, people are like fighting for jobs. You know to the point where you are like, am I safe? Am I good? But it is just a whole another level and I think that we will see basically all of these rookies the way that they adjust if it is going to be slowly or quickly or if they are going to have a gradual rise or fall in their career. But I agree, having a small circle, having a no person, and really realizing that your body is your temple, but this is why we are able to do what we do and you got to take care of it.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the physical toll of an NBA career
quotes.excerpt: My first couple years, fast food and pizza and shit before games and by my third year.
quotes.quote: My first couple years, fast food and pizza and shit before games and by my third year that shit started to affect me in ways that your sleep quality goes down, you start getting injured more. It is a well-oiled machine is what you are and I think you have your car, you are not putting regular fuel like in a Lamborghini or a Ferrari because it is just not going to run the same. It is not about what the food tastes like or what the duty is, it is literally about how your body actually runs, so you got to give it the best high-quality fuel as possible.
